senses.gloss: , אִיעַטֵּף to cover one’s self. Targ. O. Lev. l. c.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 24:65">Targ. Y. I Gen. XXIV, 65</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 104:2">Targ. Ps. CIV, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 10a:2">Sabb. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>לביש ומתכסי ימִתְעַטֵּף וכ׳</he> dressed and put an upper garment on and covered his head with it and prayed.

<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:2">Ib. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיעַטֵּף וקאי וכ׳</he> (Rashi <he>מתע׳</he>) was wrapped (in his festive cloak) and stood (ready to receive the Sabbath); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 32b">B. Kam. 32ᵇ</cite> top; a. fr.
